tools.description: The exact steps to install an employee from this catalog in a client (claude-code, codex, openclaw, hermes, or any other): which target to ask get_employee for, where each file goes, how to start the employee and how to check the files.

tools.name: search_employees
tools.description: Search the hr.harnsy.dev catalog of AI employees by words (a role, a skill, a need) and by department. Returns cards; read one with get_employee. No words lists everyone.
